     120             : /**
     121             :  * Profile specification:
     122             :  * The profile is a path defined with start, middle, and end control points projected onto a
     123             :  * plane (plane_no is normal, plane_co is a point on it) via lines in a given direction (proj_dir).
     124             :  *
     125             :  * Many interesting profiles are in family of superellipses:
     126             :  *     (abs(x/a))^r + (abs(y/b))^r = 1
     127             :  * r==2 => ellipse; r==1 => line; r < 1 => concave; r > 1 => bulging out.
     128             :  * Special cases: let r==0 mean straight-inward, and r==4 mean straight outward.
